summary: test_duplicate_error_identifies_external_file_and_remediation genuinely verifies the requirement: it writes a real external file under the (monkeypatched) home workflows dir with a duplicate builtin name, calls the real discover_workflows(), and asserts the exact error text identifies the actual file path and says to remove it; mutation testing (removing the special-case raise, and silently skipping duplicates) confirms the test rejects both a non-identifying error and a silent no-op.
